quotes.text: I loved how it was a personal cruise with friends! Sometimes especially now it’s more comfortable to be with people you know. Being able to bring drinks and snacks on board was also great. Very convenient area with a lot of parking options.
I loved the timing with the sunset, it was awesome! I also loved that you could bring snacks, drinks and listen to music all while being on the water with friends and family!​
Very relaxing time on the boat in the inner harbor which was very easy to understand. I could definitely see myself renting a boat in the future. Great experience!
The whole experience was amazing! I loved the boat and how easy it was for our group to sit and chat; and being able to see the city from the water was so fun.​
The ease of it. Renting a boat can be pretty daunting, but it’s super easy to control and the harbor was way less crowded than I imagined.
The boat was super user friendly! Something I wouldn’t expect I’d be able to do but was really doable and fun!​
